title: Dispensary Near Union Pier, MI
metaDescription: Visiting Union Pier, Lakeside, or Three Oaks? Shop our New Buffalo dispensary nearby—easy drive, fast checkout, wide selection. 21+.
h1: Cannabis Near Union Pier, Lakeside & Three Oaks (Quick Drive to New Buffalo)

hero.lead: Right off US-12 with easy parking and fast pickup—perfect for Harbor Country weekends and lake days.

images.alt: A brick High Society store with its H logo sign at dusk
A roadside Michigan fruit stand sign listing blueberries, strawberries, sweet cherries and peaches

items.title: Getting here from Union Pier (via Red Arrow Hwy → US-12)
items.md:
1. Head south on Red Arrow Hwy (M-63) toward New Buffalo.
2. Merge onto US-12 and continue toward 19189 US Hwy 12.
3. Look for High Society—easy in/out from the highway.

items.title: Parking
items.md: **Parking Notes:** Free lot on-site, best for quick grab-and-go stops. If it’s peak summer traffic, aim for earlier afternoon or later evening for the easiest in/out.

blocks.heading: Fast Pickup, Friendly Team
blocks.md: Walk in, get checked in, and head to the counter. Most visits take under 10 minutes. Our team can point you to popular categories and answer questions. We accept cash and debit; ATMs are available on site. The store and parking are accessible.

blocks.heading: For Harbor Country trips
items: Quick stop before the beach, marina, or heading back to your rental
Close to the Indiana border and the main New Buffalo corridor (US-12)
Friendly reminder: Enjoy responsibly in Michigan—don’t travel across state lines with cannabis

blocks.heading: Crossing state lines
blocks.md: Visiting from out of state? Read our guide to [Michigan marijuana laws](/cannabis-laws-by-state/michigan/) before you shop.

blocks.heading: Reviews

items.text: Very cool establishment with friendly and helpful budtenders, and a super cute receptionist that always greets me with a smile! Great deals too! Definitely worth stopping.

items.text: Very welcoming staff, and all around vibe of the place, the layout of the store is very nice and spacious, and an amazing display all around. Very clean aswell! Mae was amazing, very polite and patient! helped me find what I was looking for aswell as being informative! 10/10 atmosphere, experience, and customer service! Will defiantly be coming back!!! Thank you!
